thread:
maria_support: FYI GreenLeaf reporting large TPS drops and 429s from their Dedicated pool starting ~09:12 UTC, customer sees 'throttled: admission_control' + intermittent 401s. They say burst credits went to 0 quickly.

raj_oncall: Can you paste a sample request_id and the timeframe? I'll pull admission logs.

maria_support: Request IDs: glf-req-9932, glf-req-9937. Window 09:11:50 - 09:13:40 UTC. Customer says they sent a sudden migration event (~12k tokens/s for 40s).

ops-bot: alert: dedicated-pool-greenleaf: burst_credits=0 -> admission_throttle triggered (09:12:06). link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/2389

raj_oncall: I'm seeing admission controller metric spikes and a strange auth error pattern at the same time. Pulling logs:
```
[2026-03-12T09:12:05Z] admit_request pool=greenleaf tokens=12000 token_rate=12000 result=denied reason=burst_credit_exhausted
[2026-03-12T09:12:06Z] auth: token_lookup err=transient_failure code=500 user=greenleaf service=auth-svc
[2026-03-12T09:12:06Z] admit_request pool=greenleaf tokens=11850 result=denied reason=auth_failure
```

elaine_devex: Wait — we recently shipped an autoscaler change that delays extra nodes by 25s when admission headroom low. Could be timing edge with a burst credit drain.

sam_eng: Repro script that matches customer pattern (we used to repro locally):
```bash
# ramp to ~12k tps for 40s
for i in $(seq 1 40); do 
  seq 0 11999 | xargs -n1 -P12000 -I{} curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GLF_TOKEN" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate >/dev/null &
  sleep 1
done
```
Note: if auth svc returns 500 transiently, admission treats as auth_failure and reduces effective headroom.

raj_oncall: Confirmed: auth transient = false negative that causes admission controller to immediately mark request as failed rather than queue or retry; combined with credits hitting 0 it cascades to everyone.

maria_support: Customer also flagged a billing spike alert at 09:13 — they were charged for retries and got an unexpected invoice item.

billing-bot: invoice-event: customer=greenleaf period=2026-03-12 note="retry_charge_adjustment pending" ticket=#12345

elaine_devex: Action items: 1) Short-term: add a 3s auth retry in admission flow to avoid treating transient auth 500 as a credit-consuming denial. 2) Medium: increase soft headroom calc to reserve 10% tokens for auth flakiness. 3) Ops: consider temporary burst credit top-up for GreenLeaf while we patch.

sam_eng: I can open a PR for the retry behavior and include a flag gated to dedicated pools. Will include unit test for race between credit drain and auth failure.

raj_oncall: For immediate mitigation I've manually injected +50% burst_credits to pool greenleaf at 09:25 UTC and enabled emergency admission-queueing for 60s (so we queue up to 5s instead of immediate deny). Monitoring now.

ops-bot: action: pool_update greenleaf burst_credits=+50% performed_by=raj_oncall (09:25:11)
